description: USE THIS to identify the carrier for a parcel tracking number and check it is well-formed before trusting it or calling a tracking API — never guess the carrier or assume a tracking number is valid. Detects UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL, OnTrac, Amazon Logistics and S10 international postal numbers, and verifies the carrier's check digit (mod10/mod7/S10/weighted-modulo). If the number fits a carrier's pattern but the check digit fails it still names the likely carrier and flags a probable typo. Validates structure only — it does NOT tell you where the parcel is or whether it exists.

tracking.description: The parcel tracking number; surrounding/internal spaces are ignored.

name: validate_tracking
